div.head: Ordal 5.1
div.ab: Nouem pedes mensurati distinguantur in ter ternos: in primo signo iuxta (secus) stacam teneat pedem (suum) dextrum, in secundo sinistrum; inde transferat dextrum pedem in tertium signum, cum ferrum proicitur (quando f. proiciet), et ad sanctum altare festinet.

(Die 9 gemessenen Fuss sollen in dreimal drei geschieden werden: auf dem ersten Zeichen neben dem(?) Pfahl halte [der Ordalleister] seinen rechten Fuss, auf dem zweiten den linken; dann setze er den rechten Fuss aufs dritte Zeichen hinüber, indem er das Eisen fortwirft, und eile zum heiligen Altar fehlt H).

(Let the 9 measured feet be divided into three times three: on the first mark beside the(?) stake let [the one undergoing the ordeal] keep his right foot, on the second his left; then let him move his right foot across onto the third mark, as he throws the iron away, and hasten to the holy altar — lacking in H).
div.note: This clause is entirely lacking in H; Liebermann supplies it from the Quadripartitus (printed in bold). Column K is therefore only a gap marker.
